debug.changelog:
refactor: remove manual OTA update channel selection

- Removed `OTA_UPDATE_CHANNEL` preference and associated logic from `SettingsManager`.
- Removed the update channel selection UI, including dialogs and list items, from `SettingsScreen`.
- Updated `SettingsViewModel` and `UpdateRepository` to use the build-time `BuildConfig.UPDATE_CHANNEL` instead of a user-defined preference.
- Removed `getAvailableChannels` logic and simplified update version comparison in `UpdateRepository`.
- Added a check in `UpdateRepository` to skip update checks if the frequency is set to "disabled".
- Removed OTA channel-related string resources across all supported languages.

Refines the app launcher icon by updating foreground and background gradients to a new blue-purple-red color scheme. Adjusts the foreground shadow, reduces body stroke width, and adds a subtle inner highlight rim for improved depth.
